title: Methodology-Qualified Signal Engine Contract
description: Governs the deterministic multi-gate qualification pipeline transforming raw collective results into certified, methodology-qualified civic signals suitable for institutional and public policy delivery.
invariants: COLLECTIVE_RESULT_IS_NOT_AUTOMATICALLY_SIGNAL: Raw vote tallies or majority opinions never constitute public Signal without passing core deliberative and integrity gates.
TIERED_CONFIDENCE_STRUCTURE: Signals must be strictly classified into GOLD_STANDARD (n >= 500), SILVER_VALIDATED (n >= 250), BRONZE_OBSERVED (n >= 100), or UNQUALIFIED.
CORE_PRE_RESULT_CONTRIBUTION_ONLY: Only blind pre-result commitments qualify for signal generation to prevent outcome contagion.
ASTROTURFING_AND_SYBIL_DEFENSE: Coordinated brigading score must be >= 0.80 to ensure organic civic participation.
CRYPTOGRAPHIC_METHODOLOGY_HASH: Every qualification certificate must produce a deterministic sha256 audit hash over its evaluation record.
